visual: Green, cream and vivid pink variegation · orange-red autumn colour
prune: Prune only if needed from late autumn to midwinter
resilience: cold hardy · part-shade tolerant · urban suitable
uncertain: RHS accepts the spelling 'Oridono-nishiki'; the variant 'Orido-nishiki' also occurs on horticultural material
